title: Development of IQ at Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse Station
summary: Percentage-rate e-tender for renovating the inspection quarter at Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra: partitions, doors, windows, flooring, false ceiling, washroom plumbing and sanitary fittings, septic tank, painting and boat transport of materials.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Mumbai

sites.name: Kanhoji Angre Lighthouse Station (Island Station), Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra

scope.item: Dismantling existing unserviceable wooden/steel doors, windows, ventilators, cupboards (area 3 sqm and below)
Dismantling old plaster or skirting, raking out joints
66 mm partition with 8 mm double-skin cement board (IS 14862) on GI frame
35 mm ISI flush door shutters, decorative teak veneer, SS butt hinges
Fully glazed aluminium sliding windows, powder coated, 5 mm tinted glass
Brass 100 mm mortice latch and lock with 6 levers
125 mm brass handles
250x10 mm brass tower bolts
Brass hanging type floor door stopper
Hydraulic door closer (IS 3564)
Vitrified floor tiles 600x600 mm (Johnson/Kajaria/Nelco)
False ceiling with PVC mat board on hardwood frame
CPVC hot & cold water pipes 15/20/25/32 mm concealed and 40 mm exposed
Wall mounted single piece syphonic water closet with 10 L cistern (Jaquar/Parryware/Hindware)
Urinal basin with 5 L PVC automatic flushing cistern
Vitreous china wash basin 550x400 mm with CP brass basin mixer
600x450 mm bevelled mirror
PTMT towel rail; CP brass napkin holder; PTMT soap dish; glass shelf

Water supply fittings: bib cocks, stop cocks, angle valves, shower roses, waste couplings, waste pipes, mosquito proof couplings, telephonic wall mixers, jets, flush cocks, connection pipes, CPVC valves 25/32/40 mm, geyser flexible pipes
110 mm uPVC rain water pipes with couplers, tees, bends, CI gratings
Brick masonry gully chamber 50x45x60 cm
Masonry septic tank, 5 user capacity (drawing B/1831)
Soak pit 1.20x1.20x1.20 m
100 mm CI grating for gully trap
Repair to plaster with polymer modified mortar
18 mm black granite for kitchen platforms, vanity counters, sills
Removing old distemper/paint from walls
White cement based putty 1 mm on interior walls
Premium acrylic smooth paint with silicone additives
Polyurethane floor paint over old paver block pathway
Hire of mechanised boats/pontoons for potable water, labour and material transport from Thal jetty to Kanhoji Angre landing
Labour for carriage of construction material from Kanhoji Angre landing to lighthouse premises

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR/BG) before work order, released on satisfactory completion; plus 5% security deposit from each RA bill released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BoQ total Rs 8,33,880.60; boat hire Rs 30,000 and carriage labour Rs 30,000 included). EMD by DD/FDR in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months; MSME/NSIC bidders also required to pay EMD. Percentage-rate BoQ; quantities may vary +/-25%.

period.completion: 01 month from date of award of contract / issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central/State Govt/Municipal Corporation having tender limits >= estimated cost

Similar works (civil construction, repair and maintenance) in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% (Rs 3.34 lakh), or two each >= 60% (Rs 5.00 lakh), or one >= 80% (Rs 6.67 lakh); completion certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer; sub-contractor experience not considered
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 2,50,164) in last 3 financial years, CA certified
PAN, GST registration, ITRs for FY 2021-22 to 2023-24
Tender acceptance letter, unconditional-bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, notarised non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration, Make in India self-certification
Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory 30, financial 20, experience 20, performance 20, key personnel 10 (1 graduate civil engineer, 2 diploma civil engineers)
specs: Work per CPWD specifications Vol I-II and General Specifications for Civil Works (Section VI)
Cement board partition IS 14862 Type-B Cat-III; flush doors IS 2202 Part I; aluminium sections IS 733/IS 1285, Jindal or equivalent; Saint Gobain tinted glass
Vitrified tiles IS 15622 (Johnson/Kajaria/Nelco); sanitaryware Jaquar/Parryware/Hindware; paints Asian/Berger/Shalimar; PU floor paint Asian/Indigo/Dulux
uPVC rain water pipes IS 13592 Type A with seal rings IS 5382

unreadable: Hindi text layer partly garbled (font mojibake); English portions read

notes: Full tender document including priced BoQ (estimated rates). Inconsistencies: two-work experience threshold 60% (not the usual 50%); turnover period stated as ending 31.03.2024 in one place and 31.03.2025 in another; ITR years 2021-22 to 2023-24. Island site reachable only by boat from Thal (Alibag)/Gateway of India jetty. GCC/SCC and annexures are standard boilerplate.
